designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1943, when Shoe, Pismire and Scarecrow islands were set aside as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Michigan Islands National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS Refuge Profile, Michigan Islands NWR (UNT web archive, 2009): "established by Executive Order in 1943"
FWS ServCat: Gravel Island, Green Bay, Harbor Island, Huron, and Michigan Islands NWRs CCP
FWS ServCat: Michigan Islands NWR Habitat Management Plan (Scarecrow Island acquired 1943, one of the first islands)

review.note: FWS page says 1947; the archived FWS profile, the CCP and the HMP put establishment in 1943. FWS documents cite "Executive Order 265," which cannot be a 1943 EO number (FDR's 1943 orders were in the 9200s); possibly a Public Land Order. Authority left unchanged pending the order itself.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Michigan Islands National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1947 as a breeding ground for migratory birds.
